我现在在做什么What I'm Working On

非线性AI学习工具（网页开发）Non-linear AI Learning Tool (Web App)
你不是探索者，你是创造者。You are not an explorer — you are a creator.

如果只是在AI的回答中走马观花，那知识和你有什么关系？If you only skim the surface of an AI's answers, what does that knowledge have to do with you?

在这里，你阅读、思考、理解、追问。选中一句话，它就生长为一个新的分支；建立一个联系，它就沉淀为图谱上的一个节点。你的每一次点击，都在决定知识在你脑中的位置。Here you read, think, understand, and ask. Select a sentence and it grows into a new branch; make a connection and it becomes a node on your map. Every click decides where knowledge lives in your mind.

这个网站记录你思考的全过程，引领你继续深入——从主线到枝丫，从概念到网络，无限嵌套。它不是给你答案的工具，而是你构建思想大厦的脚手架。This site records your whole thinking process and draws you deeper — from trunk to twigs, from concepts to a network, nested without end. It is not a tool that gives you answers, but the scaffold for building your own edifice of thought.

在这里，AI不是终点，而是你创造的起点。Here, AI is not the destination — it is the starting point of your creation.
